notes.title: Our official Social Media Pages are here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217192/e5427de0862e4f7d78ecf15321f344219caed8f7.png[/img]




Dear players,

Today we got some exciting and awesome news for you all around the globe! After our amazing release on Steam in December 2019, we got so many awesome and creative players who are spread all around the globe, or in small communities and we only can imagine how many of you want to interact with us, want to tell us your stories, show us your best moments or tell us your ideas and your feedback. 

To ensure that we can provide you all of our latest patches, news, and events even better and faster, and to go sure that we can meet as many of you guys, talk to all of you, interact and have fun together, we started our official social media accounts today.

Below you can see our official social media accounts, where you will find all the latest news, patches and events as first. We are now present on Facebook and Twitter to provide fast news to all of you! To be sure that we can provide a healthy and friendly community, and to interact directly with all of you, we also created an official Community Discord-Server! Don’t miss our Server, we will provide support, will talk with you about your feedback, and we will run social events on this Server. 


➡️ [url=https://twitter.com/official_ebgame]Our official Twitter-Page[/url]
➡️ [url=https://www.facebook.com/eternalbattlefieldgame]Our official Facebook-Page[/url]
➡️ Join our official Discord-Server: https://discord.gg/cNPHvUp 


We hope we will meet as many of you as possible on our social media channels, and have a good time together in Eternal Battlefield! Thanks again for all of your support, love and passion for Eternal Battlefield, have a nice week!

Best,
Dev-Team

notes.title: 01.09.2020 Updates
notes.notes:
Dear all,

It’s been amazing days since Eternal Battlefield released. We are all grateful to see that many feedbacks helped us to realize the amount of rewards, the ways of obtaining those rewards are too few and our matchmaking mechanism does not work as expected. 

In order to address these issues:

1.	Added ‘Fortune Eye’ which enables random number within a range to be tossed and multiplies the awarded amount after each battle.

2.	Players can now invite friends to join the game and both sides can win free coins/gems.

3.	Optimized matchmaking mechanism so it prioritizes players in the same grade so players could be well matched in strength.

4.	Spending coins to summon also have chance to get Super Rare Epic unit.

5.	Adjust the grade up requirements to ensure a better grade leveling experience.

6.	Added descriptions to clearly state only one epic unit will be recruited in a group.

7.	Enable gender modification in account profile page and fixed the issue that gender shows up as male in ranking and team.

8.	Fixed/optimized translation problems.

These are only one chunk of the coming up updates. New races, new heroes, new soldier types as well as social related features are on our roadmap too, please stay tuned and noted that we are eager to interact and communicate with our players and your feedbacks are very important to us. Thank you all very much and have a nice battle!

E-mail: eternalbattlefield@hjjuntuan.com

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217192/d4e525c54e1ce867e16c7721b9299986925709e1.png[/img]

notes.title: 1st week reply to players
notes.notes:
Dear players,

It’s been a week since Eternal Battlefield released. We are very grateful to see so many reviews/comments came from truly independent mind of your players. Your support is our greatest motivation. Thank you so much.

At the meantime, we realized that certain game mechanics make some of our players unpleasant. It signifies we made a few evident mistakes. We are paying close attention to your feedback and have started improving them as our top priority at the moment. These improvements will be released as soon as possible after their development and testing phases.

Above all, many of our players complained about too little coins awarded after each battle. As a fundamental concept, players meant to receive adequate rewards after participated in each round of a game, our current setting does not substantially cover such needs. We have had discussions about this and decided to make adjustments in order to improve how coins could be obtained for instance to increase yield of coins that renders each battle more worth playing for. 

In the next place, we now understand that we misled part of our players about how awakened Epic Unit appears on the battlefield. When player recruits a group of selected units, an extra ‘one’ Epic Unit will be recruited too if it has been awakened. We designed this because it is more visualize and amusing than implicitly raise soldier stats. As part of the confusion, the reason only this Epic Unit comes with a health bar is that we are unable to display health bar for every single unit or it will cover everything underneath them. 

And we shall make apologize as well that our matchmaking system needs perfection. When online player number is low, the matching mechanism yield different results from what we expected. We have recognized this as an issue and an enhancement will be online in a few weeks.

Eternal Battlefield is a simplified war game which requires cooperation of the two teammates, where players should experience more fun when playing with their friends. We are having a lively discussion about enabling players to invite their friends into the game and receive referral bonuses.

We sincerely hope all our battlefield commanders could enjoy the game however mistakes are inevitable during the development process. Please do not hesitate to send us your opinions/advices/comments whatever it is called, for a singular reason, it is very important to us.

Thank you very much. Hope you enjoy!
Eternal Battlefield Dev Team
